_comment: This is a REFERENCE COPY, not the live tuning file. It ships in the git tree purely as a
documented template of every tunable Lane Centering understands, with the value each one
defaults to when no live file is present.
The LIVE, hot-reloaded file the controller actually reads is /data/pnw/lanecenter_tuning.json
-- deliberately OUTSIDE the openpilot git tree, so an auto-update's `git clean` can never wipe
it (see docs/mapd-binary-wiped-by-autoupdate.md for the incident this pattern is copied from).
To tune on the road: copy this file to /data/pnw/lanecenter_tuning.json on the device and edit
it there. The controller re-checks its mtime about once a second and re-parses on change --
no reboot or manager restart needed. /data/pnw/ is created automatically on controller start if
it doesn't already exist.
WRITE ATOMICALLY: write a temp file and rename it over the target (e.g. write .tmp then
`mv /data/pnw/lanecenter_tuning.json.tmp /data/pnw/lanecenter_tuning.json`) so the controller
never reads a half-written file. A caught mid-write state that still happens to be valid JSON
would load as defaults until the next real edit; an atomic rename avoids that entirely.
SAFETY NOTE: every value below is clamped in code (selfdrive/controls/lib/lane_centering.py,
see _CLAMPS) to a hardcoded safe envelope BEFORE it is ever used, no matter what this file
says. A partial file is fine -- any key you omit falls back to its default below. If the file
is missing, malformed, or fails to parse, the controller silently keeps running on these
defaults (or whatever it last loaded successfully) -- it never crashes the control loop.
Lane Centering itself is ON by default (see the DisableLaneCentering UI toggle to turn it
off entirely) -- this file only affects HOW it's tuned while it's on.
